observations.comparison: This is the first integer b in [b,b,1] that outranks [7000,7000,0] under the exact reproduced arithmetic; it wins 9333 vs 9332 despite materially weaker magnitudes on the two shared axes.

Against [7000,7000,0] at the same threshold (4666,2,9332), the accidental 1-bp breadth bonus disappears. This demonstrates that the discontinuity can be moved into an explicit versioned support policy rather than an implicit >0 rule.

observations.result: Naive additive RRF doubles the contribution when the same evidence dimension/list is counted twice. Therefore ordinal mode needs stable evidence-dimension identity and duplicate rejection; this is arithmetic demonstration, not a claim that current F2 already has such duplication.

interpretation: The E2 recommendation survives its cheapest falsifier. The current v1 overlap formula has a real discrete boundary at score 0/1. An explicit support threshold is a sufficient structural control for that boundary but does not by itself solve cross-axis calibration. Rank fusion remains a separate fallback mode and requires dimension deduplication; it is not a replacement for calibrated score semantics.
